title: campanula garganica subsp. istriaca
intro: Campanula garganica subsp. istriaca, commonly known as Istrian Bellflower, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the bellflower family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Istrian Bellflower include its use as an antiseptic, antibacterial, and antifungal agent, which may aid in the treatment of various infections and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
